_comment: Prebuilt-binary manifest for lib.sh:download_bins() / join.sh. baseUrl + file (with {os}/{arch} substituted) form the download URL; archive says how to unpack it; produces maps a logical binary name to its path *inside* the download ("" = the download IS the binary, "." = the whole extracted directory is the product, e.g. a dist dir). platforms uses {os}-{arch} keys (darwin|linux, amd64|arm64); "*" = platform-independent. sha256 keys mirror platforms (or "*"), fetched from the upstream <file>.sha256 siblings on xdc.network. Re-run the fetch and bump 'updated' if xdc.network publishes new binaries.

erigon._comment: xdc.network only publishes erigon for linux-amd64 -- darwin/arm64 stay build-from-source (lib.sh falls back automatically).

besu._comment: Java, platform-independent. Archive contains bin/besu (the launcher) + lib/*.jar.

nethermind._comment: No linux-arm64 build published. Archive is a flat .NET publish dir (./nethermind launcher + ./chainspec/*.json + ./configs/*.json at the archive root, no version-prefixed top dir), so produces path is '.' (the whole extracted dir is NETHERMIND_DIST). This archive INCLUDES chainspec/xdc-devnet5151.json (chainId 5151, genesis 0x96f121, XDPoS engine) and its runner config, so join.sh --client nethermind syncs devnet 5151 out of the box. Built from XDCIndia/xdc-nethermind-private with the net5151 follower bypass (PR #246): the legacy chain's non-standard gas schedule can't be recomputed bit-for-bit, so for chainId 5151 the header's gas-derived fields are trusted while state is fully validated -- verified syncing to the live tip.

xone._comment: xone-native (XDCIndia/xOneGo), the go-ethereum-derived XDPoS reference client. Only linux-amd64 published so far; other platforms fall back to a source build (lib.sh). NOTE: use `xone --version` (not the `version` subcommand, which boots a node).
